# Setting Introduction
In the year 2550, bluespace research by a now-unknown company resulted in the complete dissapearance of said company and a large country located in South America, as well as the erasure of all memory and records of what had dissapeared. Following this incident, SolGov, the main governing body of sapient species in the Milky Way, enacted the Blue Space Treaty, stipulating that all research into exotic materials and phenomena must be made completely public. All corporations operating in SolGov territories are required to sign this treaty.
In the year 2564, the Earth-based megacorporation Nanotrasen uncovered the substance known as "phoron" on a research expedition in the Spinward Sector's "Lavaland" system. Phoron's unusual molecular structure gives it properties bordering on magical, and it has potent applications in biology, energy production, materials science, pharmaceutics, robotics, thermodynamics, and weapons manufacturing, among other fields. Nanotrasen began the study of phoron in secret, giving them a drastic advantage in almost all fields of research and development and firmly cementing themselves as the wealthiest and most powerful corporation operating in SolGov space. Although their failure to disclose phoron research to the public is a direct violation of the Blue Space Treaty, Nanotrasen's effective monopoly on the acquisition, refinement, and distribution of phoron in SolGov space gives them a powerful political bargaining chip that they've used to evade major legal consequences.
The current year is 2566. Nanotrasen currently operates a large fleet of space stations in the Spinward Sector, remotely monitored from a classified location by their Central Command station. The stated mission of "Project 14" stations is to closely monitor and research the bluespace activity common to the sector, as well as salvaging and studying the various wrecked ships and alien artifacts drifting around the region. However, the Spinward Sector is inhabited by many dangerous creatures, and Nanotrasen's presence as a corporate titan has made them a lucrative target for thieves and corporate rivals.
Today is just another shift on the station. What could possibly go wrong?
